newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,429 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,429 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,429 contracts compared with 4,237 overnight Monday.
There were 110 wheat, 576 corn, 634 soybean, 73 soymeal, 30 soyoil, one oat, one corn call, three soybean calls and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents lower, corn was one to two cents lower and soybeans were 1-1/2 to four cents lower.
